other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand.
Applicant must suffer from one of the specified illnesses: any type of cancer, kidney transplant, severe liver diseases, or be an acid‑attack victim.
Applicant’s gross annual income must be below ₹8,00,000 for three consecutive years (exempted for acid‑attack victims).
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹5,00,000 per case for treatment of critical illnesses, disbursed directly to hospitals.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
